data: Država je odlučila stati na kraj udovicama hrvatskih branitelja koje žive u izvanbračnim zajednicama, a primaju mirovine pokojnih muževa. Za hvatanje udovica u prijestupu na teren šalju potpuno pogrešnog čovjeka, nezaposlenog biologa Krešu, posrnula samopouzdanja i u bračnoj krizi. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kada se zaljubi u jednu od udovica. (Film portrait of the Turkish painter Güler Yücel (1935-2020), wife of the political poet Can Yücel (1926-1999). Her paintings show weddings and funerals, she painted her husband and herself. In a way, her paintings tell of the cycle of life, for example, when she captures the annual almond blossom and the traditional olive harvest - all things from her own everyday life: "I can't paint anything I haven't seen," says Yücel.)

Država je odlučila stati na kraj udovicama hrvatskih branitelja koje žive u izvanbračnim zajednicama, a primaju mirovine pokojnih muževa. Za hvatanje udovica u prijestupu na teren šalju potpuno pogrešnog čovjeka, nezaposlenog biologa Krešu, posrnula samopouzdanja i u bračnoj krizi. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kada se zaljubi u jednu od udovica.

Film portrait of the Turkish painter Güler Yücel (1935-2020), wife of the political poet Can Yücel (1926-1999). Her paintings show weddings and funerals, she painted her husband and herself. In a way, her paintings tell of the cycle of life, for example, when she captures the annual almond blossom and the traditional olive harvest - all things from her own everyday life: "I can't paint anything I haven't seen," says Yücel.
